name: How much does basement trim and molding installation usually cost?
description: Cost depends on footage, material, and prep work. Simple baseboard jobs cost less; custom molding, tricky corners, and repairs raise the price.

mainEntity.name: How much does basement trim and molding installation usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing usually depends on linear footage, trim material, room layout, and how much prep or caulking is needed. Smaller baseboard-only projects can stay relatively modest, while more detailed trim work, stair transitions, or custom molding will cost more.
